//: The root project covers only what no workspace owns: `packages/*`.
This was `create-expo-app`'s file - empty options, no `include` - so
a root `tsc --noEmit` swept every workspace as well, typechecking
the Expo app's tests without jest types or the `@/` path alias and
reporting hundreds of 'Cannot find name expect'. The app was fine;
the config was reading it with the wrong settings.
`apps/mobile` has its own tsconfig and typechecks through
`npm run typecheck`. Adding a workspace here would mean two
configs claiming the same files, which is how they drift.
